about: How a film ends (tools/ci/ending.mjs). The owner, 2026-09-29: people forget to follow the page, so about every third film ends on a follow reminder instead of the closing quote. Film number n (the v<n>- of its id) is a follow film when n >= from and (n - from) % every == 0 (v43, v46, v49 ...); a redo keeps its original's ending. Its EndCard tagline and last spoken line are exactly one line of "follow", never one of the last "recent" distinct lines earlier films ended on. A line taken out of the bank moves to "retired", so the films that used it still count as follow films. A line over 26 characters is broken in two on the card at the best space (a "|" in a line sets the break by hand).
